text: Templates render with minijinja using UndefinedBehavior::Strict. An undefined variable must be a hard error that names the file and line (minijinja::Error has line()), never an empty string.
Templating is a small regex `{{var}}` replace in src/template.rs, no engine, to keep the dependency tree small.
Snapshot tests use insta. After changing rendered output run `cargo insta test --review`; snapshots live in tests/snapshots/ and CI fails if any .snap.new is left over.
MSRV is 1.74 (rust-version in Cargo.toml) and CI builds with that toolchain. Check a new dependency's MSRV before adding it; `cargo msrv verify` is quicker than waiting for CI.
Config file is ~/.dotsy.toml.
Config is read from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dotsy/dotsy.toml (via the directories crate). The old ~/.dotsy.toml still loads but prints a deprecation warning; keep both paths working in config.rs until 1.0.
On macOS the hostname crate returns names like `Foo-MacBook.local`. Strip the .local suffix before matching, otherwise per-host sections never apply.
Symlinks on Windows need Developer Mode. `dotsy apply` falls back to copy mode there and prints a hint.
Before a PR: `cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test`.
Releases: cargo-dist builds 5 targets on tag push and the workflow updates the homebrew tap. Don't edit the formula by hand.
`dotsy diff` shells out to `git diff --no-index` for colour; if git isn't on PATH it falls back to the similar crate.
Use anyhow for errors everywhere, lib included.
Library modules return DotsyError (thiserror); anyhow is only for main.rs. Template problems go in DotsyError::Template { path, line, msg }.

env.* in templates: don't hand the whole environment to the template context, people keep tokens in env. Only expose names listed under [vars.env], read with std::env::var_os, and treat non-UTF-8 values as an error.
Shell completions are generated in build.rs with clap_complete; `dotsy completions zsh` prints them.
Commit subjects: `area: imperative summary`, lowercase. git-cliff groups the changelog by area.
`dotsy watch` uses notify with a 300ms debounce. 'No space left on device' from inotify means fs.inotify.max_user_watches is too low, not a full disk.
Integration tests HOME ko tempdir pe point karke chalte hain (assert_fs). Test mein apna real home kabhi mat chhuna.
Encrypted secrets (age) were prototyped on spike/age and parked; docs/secrets.md explains why.
lib.rs has `#![doc = include_str!("../README.md")]`, so README code blocks run as doctests. Template examples in the README must actually render, mark shell snippets as ```text.
Paths banane ke liye PathBuf::join use karo, string concat se mat banao. Windows CI job turant pakad leta hai.
`dotsy status` runs from shell rc files, so startup time matters. git2 is opened lazily only for commands that need it; `hyperfine 'dotsy status'` should stay under 15ms.
